ai_summary.text:
パーク24は時間貸駐車場「タイムズ」ブランドの最大手。国内約1.9万箇所の駐車場運営に加え、カーシェアリング「タイムズカー」、海外駐車場事業（英国・豪州）を展開するモビリティプラットフォーム企業。

売上4,062億円（前年比+9.5%）、営業利益376億円（営業利益率9.2%）、純利益159億円と増収増益。コロナ禍からの人流回復が駐車場稼働率を押し上げ、カーシェアリングの会員増加も業績に寄与。ROE16.2%と高い資本効率。

自己資本比率27.7%と駐車場用地のリース負債を反映した低めの水準だが、財務健全性スコア68点。営業CF629億円と潤沢なキャッシュ創出、FCF168億円。EPS93円に対しPER19.3倍、配当30円。国内駐車場のネットワーク密度とカーシェアの成長が都市型モビリティのプラットフォーム価値を高めている。なお、EPS93.3円、PER19.3倍、1株当たり配当金30.0円の水準にあり、株主還元と企業価値の向上を両立させる経営を推進している
ai_summary.text_en: Park24 is the largest operator of the "Times" brand of hourly parking. In addition to operating approximately 19,000 parking lots in Japan, it is a mobility platform company that operates the "Times Car" car sharing service and overseas parking businesses (UK and Australia).  Sales were  406.2 billion (up 9.5% year-on-year), operating profit was  37.6 billion (operating margin of 9.2%), and net profit was  15.9 billion, an increase in both revenue and profit. The recovery of human traffic from the COVID-19 pandemic pushed up parking lot occupancy rates, and the increase in car sharing members also contributed to earnings. ROE is 16.2%, indicating high capital efficiency.  The equity ratio is 27.7%, a low level reflecting lease liabilities for parking lot land, but the financial soundness score is 68 points. Operating CF is  62.9 billion, generating abundant cash flow, and FCF is  16.8 billion. With EPS of  93 and a PER of 19.3x, the dividend is  30. The network density of domestic parking lots and the growth of car sharing are enhancing the platform value of urban mobility. The company promotes management that balances shareholder returns and corporate value enhancement with an EPS of  93.3, PER of 19.3x, and a dividend per share of  30.0.
